hero.title: A calmer start to every visit.
hero.subtitle: Visitors take a ticket on their phone and know when to come in. Staff manage queues, rooms, and screens in one place.
hero.eyebrow: Online queue for clinics and services

visual.waitHint: Your room will appear here when you're called

qr.title: QR at the counter
qr.description: Each counter or window has its own QR code. It refreshes automatically, so it can't be reused or faked.

scan.title: Scan
scan.description: The visitor points their phone camera at the code and joins the queue instantly, no app required.

wait.title: Ticket and position
wait.description: The number, position, and estimated wait time show on the visitor's phone and update on their own.

call.title: Call
call.description: When it's their turn, the visitor's phone notifies them and their number appears on the hall screen.

clinics.title: Clinics and hospitals
clinics.description: Patients wait in the hallway or outside, not crowded around the doctor's door.

gov.title: Public service centers
gov.description: Several windows serving the same request share one queue and one ticket counter.

banks.title: Banks
banks.description: Each type of transaction gets its own queue, and every counter's load is visible in real time.

universities.title: Universities
universities.description: Admissions and the registrar's office handle applicants and students through the same queue system.

antiFraud.title: Protection against queue fraud
antiFraud.description: The QR code on the screen refreshes regularly. Expired codes cannot be used to join the queue.

realtime.title: Real time
realtime.description: Queue position, counter status, and calls update instantly, without refreshing the page.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Average wait and service time, no-show rate, and load by hour all land in one report.

home.welcomeIntro: Five steps to issue tickets and show calls on a screen.
home.readyIntro: Check waiting visitors, queue status, and TV connections.
home.setupIntro: Create a service queue, a room, and a staff account. Then connect a display.

queue.title: Add a queue
queue.description: A queue is a service, such as “Therapy” or “Cash desk”.

cabinet.title: Add a room
cabinet.description: This is where staff call visitors from the queue.

operator.title: Add an operator
operator.description: Create an account for a staff member who will call tickets.

assignment.title: Assign the operator to a room
assignment.description: Once assigned, they can see their queue and start serving visitors.

screen.title: Connect a TV display
screen.description: Create a queue screen and enter its pairing code on the TV. It will show a QR code.

home.howIntro: After setup, the visitor journey is simple:

how.qr: Scan the TV QR code and choose a queue.
how.ticket: Receive a ticket number on their phone.
how.call: See their call on TV and go to the room.
